# Minecraft Gold Text

Turn your gold-income popup into a Minecraft item collection.

![Version preview](https://i.postimg.cc/GhCKqnSy/version.png)

Click the **Versions** tab to download your preferred Gold Text version.

Available versions:

- Cookie
- Golden Melon
- Golden Carrot
- Golden Apple
- Netherite
- Redstone
- Totem
- Eye of Ender
- XP Bottle
- Cake
- Blaze Powder

"Washed Textures" Fix is public and available.
Update ur mods(redownload in versions Tab) for best quality :D.

Inspired by [@frog](https://divineskins.gg/frog) — he’s doing great work. Credits to him for the inspiration.

Got an idea for another Gold Text mod? Send recommendations! I’m always looking for fun new ones to make.
